headline: Keirsey Temperament, from entry to detail
overview: Take a 70-question assessment to find your temperament across the four Keirsey groups: Artisan, Guardian, Idealist, and Rational.

keyFeatures: 70-question assessment identifying your core Keirsey temperament
Maps to one of four temperament groups: Artisan, Guardian, Idealist, or Rational
Focuses on observable behavior patterns and communication styles
Insights into how your temperament shapes your relationships, work preferences, and decision-making
tips: Keirsey focuses on what you do rather than why — answer based on your consistent behavioral patterns across different situations.
Compare your Keirsey temperament with your MBTI type to see how the two frameworks reinforce and complement each other.
